theme.concept: Finanças Pro — Deep Slate & Warm Amber Precision
theme.description: A high-precision personal finance command dashboard designed as an installable desktop PWA for Brazilian Portuguese (BRL - R$). Avoids generic bank green/blue slop. Uses deep obsidian slate (#0B0F17) with refined indigo/steel structural cards, sharp borders, warm amber/gold accents (#F59E0B) for investments, vibrant emerald (#10B981) for entries/receitas, energetic rose/coral (#F43F5E) for expenses/saídas, and royal violet (#8B5CF6) for categorical analytics.

entry_surfaces./: Header with PWA install button & navigation pills top, Month/Year selector ribbon below, 4 distinct tactical KPI cards, split 2-column or dual-card layout for Receitas and Despesas data tables with Category Analytics Donut & side drawer for observations.

app_shell.header: Fixed top bar with subtle crystal dark glass (bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800), app logo 'FinanControl PWA', tabs/nav links (Painel do Mês, Relatório Anual, Categorias & Observações, Análise & Filtros), quick '+ Nova Transação' button, and 'Instalar App' PWA CTA button.
app_shell.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6

month_selector_ribbon.style: Horizontal scrollable pill list for 12 months (Jan..Dez) with active glow + Year dropdown selector (2024, 2025, 2026, 2027), month summary quick preview.

tables_section.receitas_table: xl:col-span-5 bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm
tables_section.despesas_table: xl:col-span-7 bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm
tables_section.features: Dense row rendering supporting up to 100+ transactions with virtual/smooth scrolling, quick search bar, category badge pills with custom hex colors, inline quick action icons (edit, duplicate, delete), and summary footer with total values in Brazilian Real.

category_breakdown.visualization: Recharts ResponsiveContainer PieChart/Donut chart with custom animated hover segments, centered total expenditure, and accompanying dense percentage table with color badges and count of transactions.

manifest.name: FinanControl - Gestão Financeira Pessoal
manifest.description: Controle financeiro pessoal completo com banco de dados, relatórios e filtros

pwa_requirements.install_prompt_handler: Capture `beforeinstallprompt` event in window, display dynamic 'Instalar no PC / Celular' button in header that triggers prompt and updates state to 'Instalado'.

painel_mensal.description: Visão detalhada do mês selecionado. Inclui KPIs, tabela de receitas, tabela de despesas (com suporte a alta densidade ~80+ linhas), gráfico Donut de despesas por categoria/observação e modais de inclusão/edição rápida.

relatorio_anual.description: Tabela consolidada dos 12 meses com Entradas, Saídas, Saldo Calculado, Investimento (editável inline ou por modal) e Totais anuais. Acompanha gráfico de barras comparativo (Entradas vs Saídas) com linha de Investimento e ranking anual de gastos por categoria.

gerenciamento_categorias.description: Painel de configuração de Categorias / Observações (ex: Gasolina, Mercado, Lanche, Fixo, Compra Física, etc). Permite criar nova categoria, escolher cor e ícone, editar nome, excluir e ver quantidade de transações atreladas e valor total acumulado.

analise_filtros.description: Ferramenta avançada de filtragem por categoria (ex: ver exatamente quanto gastou de 'Gasolina' ou 'Mercado' em determinado mês ou no ano todo). Exibe total gasto, número de lançamentos, evolução mensal em gráfico e lista completa de transações filtradas.

motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up using motion/react with 0.2s duration ease-out
motion.chart_hover: 0.15s ease transition on bar and pie segment hover
motion.kpi_counters: Smooth numeric update animation on month change

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab order across month selectors, transaction tables, and action modals.
accessibility.aria_labels: Clear Portuguese aria-labels for icon buttons (Excluir transação, Editar transação, Instalar aplicativo).
accessibility.contrast_compliance: All text and numeric displays exceed 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG AA contrast against slate-900 / slate-950 surfaces.
accessibility.monospaced_numbers: Monospaced numerals (tabular-nums font-mono) for strict alignment in financial tables.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install needed font imports in frontend/src/index.css using '@fontsource-variable/outfit', '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans', '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'.

Ensure FastAPI backend has routes for /api/transactions (CRUD + batch seed from initial spreadsheet data), /api/categories (CRUD for custom categories/observações), /api/investments, /api/annual-summary, and /api/analytics/filter.

Pre-seed realistic data for all 12 months with common categories: Gasolina, Mercado, Lanche, Fixo, Compra Física, Farmácia, Lazer, etc., so the user immediately sees a populated and functioning financial command center.
Format all currency values in BRL ('R$ 1.234,56') using Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }) or helper function.
Include PWA Manifest in public/manifest.json and service worker registration so the app can be installed natively on desktop/mobile.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tables, and filters have the prescribed data-testid attributes.
